purpose: Teach: 文春/獅子/宇都宮/旭川/尼崎/豊田/西ドイツ/出雲

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが文春の記事を読んでらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was reading an article from Bunshun magazine.
lines.style: Gentle, informative delivery. Warm tone—she's sharing something about his father. Slight lift on the name "Sho" to get his attention. Calm, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと獅子舞見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I saw the lion dance!
lines.style: Bright, eager energy. Quick pace with excitement bubbling through. Opens strong on "Mom." Natural child's emphasis—he's proud he has this to share. No filter, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが宇都宮餃子を取り寄せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father ordered those Utsunomiya dumplings you like.
lines.style: Calm, slightly warm. She's sharing this detail as something he might notice—small kindnesses from his father. Quiet satisfaction in her voice. Even pace, gentle trailing-off.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと旭川動物園行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I went to the Asahikawa Zoo!
lines.style: Bright, genuine excitement. Immediate energy shift—he's bursting to tell this. Quick delivery with a natural rise at the end. Pure, unguarded joy in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが尼崎の取引先と打ち合わせされるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father has a meeting with a client in Amagasaki coming up.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm. She's narrating his father's day like a quiet observer. Steady pace. No drama—just factual, with underlying affection in the tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと豊田の博物館行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I went to the Toyota Museum!
lines.style: High, eager delivery. Rapid-fire excitement—he can't wait to get the words out. Opens strong, maintains brightness throughout. The voice of a child who knows he has something good to tell.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが西ドイツ駐在のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was telling me about when he was stationed in West Germany.
lines.style: Warm, reflective tone. She's sharing something more substantial now—a memory or story from his father's past. Slower pace. Slight reverence in the delivery, like she's honoring what he shared.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと出雲大社で初詣したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I went to Izumo Shrine for New Year!
lines.style: Peak brightness. Strong opening energy that sustains. Quick, joyful pace. The finality of the exclamation mark carries through—this is a big moment to share. Pure, uncomplicated happiness.
